title: Small molecule sonosensitizers in cancer therapy: recent advances and clinical prospects
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00088B, Review Article
Dan Li, Yongjie Zhu, Weiwen Yin, Xintong Lin, Goeun Kim, Zhaoyang Liu, Sungwook Jung, Jiwoo Seo, Sumin Kim, Jong Seung Kim, Huaiyi Huang, Pingyu Zhang
This review highlights recent advancements in small molecule sonosensitizers for cancer therapy, focusing on their design strategies, clinical applications, and existing limitations.
